description: This line plot illustrates the training loss evolution over iterations for three variants of the SepLLM model, with the y-axis representing "Loss" on a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 3.0 and the x-axis representing "#Iteration" on a linear scale ranging from 95,000 to 125,000. The plot includes three distinct lines: a magenta solid line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)", a blue solid line labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", and an orange solid line labeled "SepLLM (n=64)". A red dashed horizontal line is also present at a loss value of 2.35, likely indicating a target or baseline loss. All three loss curves begin near a loss value of 3.0 at iteration 95,000 and exhibit a general downward trend, decreasing to approximately 2.25 by iteration 125,000. The magenta line (n=64, larger lr) shows the steepest initial decline and reaches the lowest final loss value. The blue line (n=128) follows a similar trajectory but remains slightly above the magenta line throughout. The orange line (n=64) is positioned between the magenta and blue lines, showing a decline that is less steep than the magenta line but more pronounced than the blue line. All three curves exhibit some fluctuation, particularly in the early iterations, before stabilizing.
